title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Massey Hall, Toronto | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Massey Hall in Toronto, Canada, on 28 September 2022.

It was the 27th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr had previously performed at Massey Hall on 20 October 2015.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
